options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(os_user_domain_name) or I(os_project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* e

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: availability_zones
options.description: Specifies the list of AZs where the load balancer is created.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: description
options.description: Provides supplementary information about the load balancer.

options.name: eips
options.description: Specifies the EIP bound to the load balancer.

options.name: elb_virsubnet_type
options.description: Specifies the type of the subnet on the downstream plane. ipv4 IPv4 subnets. dualstack subnets that support IPv4/IPv6 dual stack. IPv6 is unsupported. The value cannot be 6.

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: Specifies the virtual IP address bound to the load balancer.

options.name: ip_version
options.description: Specifies the IP version. The value can be only 4 (IPv4).

options.name: l4_flavor_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the flavor at Layer 4.

options.name: l4_scale_flavor_id
options.description: Specifies the elastic flavor that is reserved for now.

options.name: l7_flavor_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the flavor at Layer 7.

options.name: l7_scale_flavor_id
options.description: Specifies the elastic flavor that is reserved for now.

options.name: limit
options.description: Specifies the number of records on each page. Minimum 0. Maximum 2000.

options.name: marker
options.description: Specifies the ID of the last record on the previous page. This parameter must be used together with limit. If this parameter is not specified, the first page will be queried. This parameter cannot be left blank or set to an invalid ID.

options.name: member_address
options.description: Specifies the private IP address of the backend server.

options.name: member_device_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the cloud server that serves as a backend server. This parameter is used only as a query condition and is not included in the response.

options.name: name_or_id
options.description: Specifies the load balancer name or ID.

options.name: operating_status
options.description: Specifies the operating status of the load balancer. The value can only be ONLINE, indicating that the load balancer is working normally.

options.name: page_reverse
options.description: Specifies the page direction. Default is false. This parameter must be used together with limit. The last page in the list requested with page_reverse set to false will not contain the "next" link, and the last page in the list requested with page_reverse set to true will not contain the "previous" link.

options.name: port_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the port bound to the virtual IP address of the load balancer.

options.name: provisioning_status
options.description: Specifies the provisioning status of the load balancer. The value can only be ACTIVE, indicating that the load balancer is provisioned successfully.

options.name: publicips
options.description: Specifies the public IP address bound to the load balancer.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the subnet where the load balancer works.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long should ansible wait for the requested resource.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(yes).

options.name: vpc
options.description: Specifies the name or ID of the VPC where the load balancer works.

options.name: wait
options.description: Should ansible wait until the requested resource is complete.
